_about: Every number a monetary figure of the platform depends on, and where it comes from (feedback: facts only). A money figure may be shown, frozen, filed, used in a KRI or printed in a signed document only when every input is (a) the customer's own data, (b) a regulatory parameter quoted from the text, (c) the output of a model that passed its validation gate FOR THAT QUANTITY, or (d) arithmetic on these. A method or parameter the institution chooses is (a): it is STATED here as a figure of the family 'method' (provided values, per financial year, attested by a second person) — the platform never supplies a default. Not stated → the figure is a named gap. 'constants' lists every number literal in a money module ('path:scope:value') with why it is not a guess (a definition of what is reported, a computation setting, a quoted text, a versioned reference dataset); 'modules' are the money modules already clean; 'pending' the ones still to convert (the worklist). tests/unit/test_money_parameters.py refuses any other number. Read by services/money/params.py.

band.label: hazard band of the platform's 0-100 score (core.types: L < 25 ≤ M < 50 ≤ H < 75 ≤ VH)

peril.label: peril (a hazard channel), or 'any' — the institution's value for every peril it does not state separately

peril_band.label: peril / hazard band (e.g. flood/H), or any/<band> — the institution's value for every peril it does not state separately

division_scenario_horizon.label: NACE division @ scenario / horizon (e.g. C24@disorderly_2c/2030), or any@<scenario>/<horizon> — the institution's value for every division it does not state separately

nace_division.label: NACE division (Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 1893/2006), e.g. C24

epc_grade.label: energy performance certificate grade (A best … G worst)

method.t1_sector_scope3_intensity.label: Sector-average scope 3 emissions intensity of a NACE division, in tCO2e per EUR million of a counterparty's total liabilities and equity — as the source the institution uses publishes it (stated with the source's name and year)
method.t1_sector_scope3_intensity.used_for: Pillar 3 Template 1 columns i-j: the scope 3 of a counterparty whose scope 3 is not gathered from it (Annex XL: 'Institutions shall base the estimation of scope 3 emissions on the information on emissions gathered from their counterparties and on the information on sector-average emissions intensity.')

method.at_risk_level.label: The hazard score (0-100) at or above which the institution treats an exposure as at material physical risk
method.at_risk_level.used_for: value at material physical risk; exposures sensitive to physical risk (Pillar 3 Template 5); forward crossings; the decision spine's at-risk line

method.valuation_haircut.label: Share of an asset's (collateral) value the institution discounts for physical climate risk, by peril and hazard band of the asset's headline hazard
method.valuation_haircut.used_for: climate-adjusted value and loan-to-value, value-loss band, climate VaR, resilience capex (the loss a retrofit addresses)

method.damage_ratio.label: Mean damage ratio if a damaging event occurs — the share of the exposure's value lost — by peril and hazard band (the institution's own curve)
method.damage_ratio.used_for: expected loss (bank), scenario loss, expected annual loss and technical premium (insurer, property), catastrophe simulation

method.annual_event_probability.label: Annual probability of a damaging event, by peril and hazard band (the institution's own frequency)
method.annual_event_probability.used_for: expected annual loss (bank and insurer), technical premium, catastrophe simulation

method.var_relative_uncertainty.label: Relative uncertainty of a holding's haircut for the Monte-Carlo VaR (the triangular band is the haircut × (1 ± this))

method.expense_ratio.label: Expense ratio loaded on the technical premium (share of the premium)

method.profit_margin.label: Profit margin loaded on the technical premium (share of the premium)

method.adaptation_effectiveness.label: Share of the physical value loss a resilience retrofit avoids, by peril
method.adaptation_effectiveness.used_for: resilience capex: avoided loss and benefit-cost ratio

method.resilience_capex_share.label: Resilience retrofit capex as a share of the asset's value, by hazard band

method.stranded_share.label: Share of an exposure's value at risk of stranding in the low-carbon transition, by NACE division, under a scenario and horizon (the institution's own)
method.stranded_share.used_for: transition expected loss (bank), combined physical + transition climate VaR (asset manager)

method.carbon_price.label: Carbon price in EUR per tonne of CO2e under a scenario and horizon (the institution's own, e.g. from the NGFS vintage it uses)
method.carbon_price.used_for: carbon cost of a counterparty's emissions (transition overlay)

method.transition_var_relative_uncertain.label: Relative uncertainty of a holding's stranded share for the combined VaR (the triangular band is the share × (1 ± this))
method.transition_var_relative_uncertain.used_for: combined physical + transition climate VaR (asset manager)

method.frequency_review_tolerance.label: How far the observed event frequency at a policy may differ from the priced frequency before the review flags it (share: observed ≥ priced × (1 + this) → possibly under-priced; ≤ × (1 − this) → possibly conservative)

method.brown_discount.label: Share of a building's value the institution discounts for its energy performance (transition: tightening minimum energy-performance standards), by EPC grade — 0 for a grade it does not discount
method.brown_discount.used_for: energy-stranding value at risk (real estate), collateral value at risk and stressed LTV (bank)

method.retrofit_capex_share.label: Retrofit capex to bring a building of this EPC grade to the performance the institution's standard requires, as a share of its value — 0 where none is needed
method.retrofit_capex_share.used_for: retrofit capex to de-risk (real estate, bank collateral)

method.runway_materiality.label: Share of the book newly crossing the stated at-risk level by a horizon that the institution treats as material — the earliest such horizon is the runway ('act by')

method.bi_downtime_share.label: Expected share of the year an own site is down from physical hazard, by peril and hazard band of the site's headline hazard (the company's own)
method.bi_downtime_share.used_for: business interruption at risk at own sites (operations, ESRS E1 own operations)

method.reallocation_cap.label: Largest share of a commodity's spend the company treats as shiftable to a lower-risk origin it already sources, near-term (its own procurement judgement)
